summary: Iter 500 CTC Module (Phases 1-3) tested end-to-end. Backend: 12/12 pytest pass (test_iter500_ctc_module.py). Verified: (1) GET /api/admin/ctc/structures auto-seeds exactly 3 default templates (Standard Office CTC, Compliance / Labour CTC, Flexible / Custom CTC) idempotently. (2) POST /api/admin/ctc/preview with monthly_ctc=30000 + Standard Office structure returns breakup where round(gross+employer_total)==30000, basic ≈ 50% of gross, net_salary == gross - deduction_total; POST rejects monthly_ctc=0 with 400. (3) Structure CRUD works — create/update/delete all 200; DELETE returns 400 with 'assigned' detail when an employee is assigned to the structure. (4) Firm-mode GET/PUT accepts gross/ctc/mixed, rejects other with 400; restored to 'gross' post-test. (5) POST /api/admin/ctc/assign switches user_f7dca2400840 (SURENDRA SINGH, code 50) to CTC mode with monthly_ctc=30000; GET /employees shows salary_mode=ctc + annual_ctc=360000; GET /revisions records the transition. Validation: assign mode=ctc without monthly_ctc OR without structure_id → 400. (6) GET /api/admin/ctc/summary returns all expected keys (ctc_employees, total_monthly_ctc, total_annual_ctc, total_employer_cost, total_net_payout, avg_monthly_ctc, by_structure). (7) Phase-2 payroll hook — POST /api/admin/compliance-salary-runs for fresh month 2026-11 successfully generated 127 rows; the test employee's row carries ctc_mode=true, monthly_ctc=30000, ctc_employer_total>0, ctc_gross_derived in [27500,29000] (Standard Office template with 30000 CTC → gross ~28300). Other 20+ sampled rows carry NO ctc_mode field (backward compatibility confirmed). (8) GET /api/admin/employee-payslip.pdf?...&month=2026-07 returned a valid PDF (%PDF header, >2000 bytes). Frontend on 1920x1080 desktop (super_admin sksharmaconsultancy@gmail.com/sharma123): /ctc-management renders 3 template cards + summary cards + Company Salary Mode chips (ctc-mode-gross/ctc/mixed) + tabs (CTC Structures / Employee Register (127) / Revision History (8)). 'New CTC Structure' opens builder modal — all testIDs present (ctc-new-structure, ctc-b-name, ctc-add-comp, ctc-prev-amt, ctc-prev-btn, ctc-b-save). Employee Register tab renders 127 rows with 41 ctc-assign-<code> buttons visible above the fold. Revision History tab loads with 8 revision entries. Menu entry '/ctc-management' present under Payroll > Salary Process (AdminWebShell.tsx:154 and :534). CLEANUP verified via direct MongoDB check: 0 leftover TEST_ITER500 structures, 0 leftover 2026-11 compliance runs / master snapshots / freeze snapshots, firm_mode restored to 'gross', 0 CTC-mode employees remaining. No React Native deprecations (expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch) detected in Iter 500 touched code.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/admin/ctc/preview accepts a bare structure_id without scoping to company_id — a super_admin or sub_admin (write+read roles both) could preview any other company's custom structure if they know the ID. Not a serious leak (UUIDs are opaque and only earnings percentages exposed), but scoping to caller's accessible company_ids would be tighter.
ctc_module.py at ~437 lines is well under the 700-line threshold; single-file placement is fine for now.

calc_ctc_breakup uses a fixed-point iteration (10 rounds) to converge gross = CTC − employer_cost; verified numerically that Standard Office template converges within 1 iteration for 15000/30000/100000 CTC.
Register response correctly excludes MongoDB _id via projection {'_id': 0} on all queries.
